reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis is scientifically sound: ML potentials trained on ab initio liquid data are known to better capture many-body interactions and configurational diversity than EAM, which directly addresses the phase-space overlap problem in thermodynamic integration.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and decisive, specifying a controlled comparison, quantitative metrics (integration path residuals), and a falsification threshold (less than ~20% improvement), though practical execution details (e.g., alloy system, ML training protocol) are left implicit.
reasons.usefulness: This is a highly useful, actionable hypothesis that directly tackles the core limitation of TOR-TILD for high-entropy liquids, offering a concrete methodological advance with a clear benchmark for success.
